# With My Voice

> Ethical US college application essay mentoring for international students, by Emma O. Bérat, PhD (Columbia University, English and Comparative Literature). €50 per hour. Based in Pau, France; works with students worldwide, in English or French.

With My Voice offers discussion, feedback, and light editing on Common App and college-specific essays. The student writes the essay: the service does not ghostwrite, choose topics or colleges, submit applications, or guarantee admission.

## Key facts
- Mentor: Emma O. Bérat, PhD. Former chief editor at a college admissions company; taught University Writing at Columbia; TESOL-certified; professional editor for 8+ years.
- Price: €50 per hour. Payment by bank transfer or PayPal; invoice and receipt provided.
- Who it suits: students applying to US colleges, especially international students writing in English as a second language, and their parents.
- First step: a free 20-minute call, booked by email (editor.emmaberat@gmail.com).
